label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 11: Exercise of the right of withdrawal
1. Before the expiry of the withdrawal period, the consumer shall inform the trader of his decision to withdraw from the contract. For this purpose, the consumer may either:
(a) use the model withdrawal form as set out in Annex I(B); or
(b) make any other unequivocal statement setting out his decision to withdraw from the contract.
Member States shall not provide for any formal requirements applicable to the model withdrawal form other than those set out in Annex I(B).
raw_output: This applies when a customer wants to cancel a purchase after buying goods or services. The business needs to provide a clear form or an easy way for the customer to express their decision to cancel.
enrichment: This applies when a customer wants to cancel a purchase after buying goods or services. The business needs to provide a clear form or an easy way for the customer to express their decision to cancel.
